label: Necessary origin with existential inertia against the esse-priority source bundle
summary: PR #1891 (docs/notes/sustaining-vs-existential-inertia.md §9) adds four *unregistered* Lean theorems in Results.Causality.EsseCausePriority.InertialNecessaryOrigin, checked by lake build and NanoDa over affected modules (unregistered helpers are not Comparator targets), first at head 050929a0fae9ee2a02feb13d692b2a03235a0828. Reuse the C3ActualWorld same-bearer cause-and-giving dictionary, with necessary source true existent in both accessible worlds and at every moment, contingent received-esse effect false at actual world true for times >= 1, origin-only GivesAt at t=1, StepPersistence throughout, CoherentAtNow at now=2, and no being-giving at t=2. NecessaryOriginWithoutConservation combines necessary actual source root, every contingent actual concrete grounded in that source on historical-ancestry reading, receipt of effect, and failures of both C3/ConcurrentlyActualized 40a97664 and causing-another's-being-is-sustaining ce55210c. FullSourceOmission satisfies the TEN other *source-level* premises from #1614's esse-priority subgraph at the same cause/target/respect in a strict branch that withholds BOTH the grounding edge (so cb1cdea9 fails, and the grounding clause holds vacuously) and the priority edge (PriorSimply empty); cb1cdea9 is the only premise there that forces any priority. The two priority intermediate conclusions fail at the pair true/false, and the first-being/component consequences fail at the caused composite contingent effect false only because nothing is prior to anything, so every being is vacuously first. These failures come from the separate choice of an empty PriorSimply, not from denying cb1cdea9: PriorityWithoutGroundEdge keeps the same ungrounded profile with the ancestry priority, and there the ten premises and all priority/first-being/component conclusions hold. Denying origin priority is an extra interpretive commitment that DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY's 'not in time' does not settle. The inherited component relation makes the effect false a component of its originator true (a two-being artifact). No derived target is supplied as a premise. AncestorRouteWithoutConservation instead keeps cb1cdea9 as historical actual-ground and a simply-prior edge, and composes the existing five #1614 result theorems to priority/pure-act/component conclusions while C3 remains false. Neither case establishes that the ancestry assignment is a valid strict metaphysical ground, that the law supplies ultimate whole-history actuality, or that any finite interpretation is metaphysically possible. Originating causation and necessary-source actuality do not entail concurrent giving on the selected existing formal semantics. The two versions are *interpretations of the same ground/priority primitives*, not newly named concepts, and do not discharge any root-route premise or provide independent philosophical warrant. Rival-foundation scope: on the strict withoutGround profile EveryContingentGroundedAt fails and false is an ungrounded contingent actual root, so the claim that inertia need not mean foundationlessness holds only on the ancestry reading; mixing ancestry grounds for the root premises with strict grounds for cb1cdea9 would equivocate.
